Specification: This module models an asynchronous Byzantine agreement protocol based on the Bracha-Toueg protocol, using counters for sent and received ECHO and READY messages together with per-process program counters. The fault model is Byzantine with up to F faulty processes, under the assumption N > 3 * T, T >= F, and F >= 0, and faults are introduced explicitly by a BecomeByzantine action. The specification defines initial states, step actions, a next-state relation, weak fairness for message receipt and protocol progress actions, and temporal properties for type correctness, unforgeability-style safety, eventual acceptance when all start with value 1, and eventual agreement after some process accepts.
